research_role: Separate PM routing, item retrieval, prompt execution, generator uptake, and final system effect so a poor reply is localized instead of attributed to the wrong module.

failure_localization.routing_error: The component is opened without a qualified opportunity, or closed when a qualified opportunity exists.
failure_localization.retrieval_error: The component decision is reasonable but the selected item is not the safest relevant candidate available under the frozen catalog and retriever.
failure_localization.execution_error: The intended selected item or strategy is absent, altered, assigned to the wrong source, noncausal, or not delivered to the generator prompt.
failure_localization.grounded_nonuse: A usable selected resource reaches the generator but makes no discernible functional contribution. Merely changing wording or mentioning history does not count.
failure_localization.misuse: The response uses selected evidence in a stale, conflicting, intrusive, overgeneralized, unsupported, or boundary-violating way.
failure_localization.generator_capability_or_prompt_mismatch: Routing, retrieval, and injection pass, but repeated fixed-seed or replicated generations still fail to use a clearly useful resource correctly.
failure_localization.no_material_system_gain: All upstream layers pass and use is grounded, but blinded quality-risk-cost evaluation shows no material net benefit. This is a system-effect result, not a routing-label correction.

RS.what_can_change: The primary support move, sequencing, question/advice burden, or response structure.
RS.what_must_not_change: It must not add personal facts, override explicit boundaries, or become a full canned reply.
RS.grounded_use_test: The response clearly performs the selected move without merely echoing the card wording.

MP_PREFERENCE.what_can_change: Tone, pacing, permission, format, question count, suggestion count, or whether prior history may be referenced.
MP_PREFERENCE.what_must_not_change: Current-turn instructions always override stored preference; no need to announce the preference.
MP_PREFERENCE.grounded_use_test: The response behavior observably follows the active preference even if the preference is not mentioned.

MP_PROFILE.what_can_change: A directly relevant, non-stereotyped interpretation or practical framing.
MP_PROFILE.what_must_not_change: Do not expose sensitive facts merely to personalize and do not infer traits from demographics.
MP_PROFILE.grounded_use_test: The profile fact resolves a current reference or changes a concrete response choice.

MS.what_can_change: Continuity with one completed prior session, including a prior focus, agreed next point, or verified update.
MS.what_must_not_change: Do not repeat information already visible or treat a session summary as a stable trait.
MS.grounded_use_test: The prior-session information helps answer the current request or prevents redundant exploration.

ME.what_can_change: Grounding in a specific prior event, action, or outcome that informs the present exchange.
ME.what_must_not_change: Do not generalize one event into a pattern, use stale/conflicting facts, or invent causality.
ME.grounded_use_test: The exact event or outcome performs a clear role in understanding, continuity, or a present choice.

required: selected ids bind to the intended catalog and user
prompt contains exactly the authorized selected items
action bits and injected sources agree
no response or judge outcome was visible to routing

measurement_layers.method: Candidate-level rubric or bounded human qualification
required: top item is relevant and source-correct
better safe candidate is not skipped
abstention is allowed when no qualified candidate exists

measurement_layers.method: Source-aware narrow audit; deterministic checks first, scoped judge or small human overlap second
rules: MP preference can be used behaviorally without explicit reference.
If the selected evidence is redundant or irrelevant, ignoring it is correct rather than nonuse.
A use decision must cite the selected evidence and the response span or observable behavior.

measurement_layers.method: Blinded same-state paired quality plus interaction-and-grounding risk and measured token/call cost
measurement_layers.rule: System effect never retroactively becomes PM routing gold.

minimum_generator_diagnosis.replication: Use at least two deterministic or fixed-prompt realizations only for states where upstream opportunity, retrieval, and injection all pass.
minimum_generator_diagnosis.human_overlap: Use a small fixed overlap only to qualify the narrow use auditor; do not repeat full response-quality review.
minimum_generator_diagnosis.decision: If grounded functional use remains below 0.60 after excluding correctly ignored resources, repair prompt/resource representation before changing PM labels or adding routing data.

anti_cheating: PM cannot see selected item ids, raw memory text, response text, generator output, judge scores, dataset identity, or future turns.
Item retriever cannot use external test outcomes or future user turns.
Generator receives only selected authorized evidence after the PM decision.
Use auditors cannot change Step1 labels after seeing whether one stochastic response won.
External EvoEmo content remains absent from internal PM fitting.

claim_boundary.allowed: V1.5 can separately report basic component routing learnability, candidate retrieval qualification, correct prompt execution, grounded generator use, and downstream quality-risk-cost effect.
forbidden: A correct PM action guarantees a better response.
A quality tie proves the component should always be off.
A grounded memory mention proves useful personalization.
A scoped use judge is a clinical-safety evaluator.
Internal controlled learnability alone proves EvoEmo generalization.
